census.evidence_summary: McVay confirmed after the combine that he will continue calling the Rams offense.
Baltimore explicitly identified Doyle as the caller and said he will work from the booth.
Brady said he will retain play-calling as head coach and move from the booth to the sideline.
Seattle explicitly identifies Fleury as its 2026 caller and notes this is his first NFL season calling plays.
Current Lions coverage identifies Petzing as the 2026 offensive play caller.
NFL.com identifies Mannion as the first-time caller placed in charge of Philadelphia's offense.
The Bengals explicitly state that Taylor remains the primary play caller with input from Pitcher and the staff.
New England's preseason delegation account distinguishes McDaniels as the regular offensive caller.
Current NFL.com coverage explicitly identifies Reid as Kansas City's primary play caller after Bieniemy's return.
The Texans beat reporter documents Caley entering his second season calling Houston's offense.
San Francisco previously confirmed Shanahan retained the role; current coverage limits Kubiak's delegated calls to camp and preseason.
The Chargers explicitly describe McDaniel making the offensive calls in 2026.
LaFleur confirmed at the 2026 league meeting that he remains Green Bay's play caller.
Payton formally announced that Webb will call Denver's offensive plays, while retaining override authority.
Current Bears coverage identifies Johnson as the offensive play caller while Taylor coordinates the unit.
Dallas states that Schottenheimer will continue calling the offense in 2026.
Jacksonville notes Coen returned to the headset after delegating the first two preseason games to assistants.
Current Vikings coverage identifies O'Connell as Minnesota's offensive play caller entering 2026.
McCarthy explicitly said he will call the Steelers offense.
Buccaneers coverage explicitly discusses Robinson as the new offensive play caller.
Current Colts coverage describes Steichen's 2026 camp work and decisions as the team's play caller.
Moore answered yes when asked whether he was calling plays after the preseason finale.
Harbaugh's explanation of preseason backup-caller work makes Nagy the regular offensive caller.
Official team coverage identifies Blough as Washington's new caller, supported by his discussion of relaying calls to the quarterback.
Canales formally delegated 2026 play-calling to Idzik.
Stefanski announced that Rees will call Atlanta's offensive plays.
NFL.com describes Tennessee's hire as adding an experienced independent offensive caller while Saleh calls the defense.
A current Browns transcript addresses Monken in his role as play caller and his handling of player usage.
The Jets explicitly identify Reich as the caller and say he will work from the booth.
Slowik's introductory press conference addresses his decisions and process as Miami's play caller.
LaFleur directly said he will call Arizona's offensive plays.
Raiders coverage describes Janocko coordinating the offense around Kubiak's game-day play-calling role.
